gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Change in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, printed p8): User fees 426,278 + Other 4,734 = Total operating revenues 431,012. The only business-type schedule is the Budgetary Basis Budget and Actual - Proprietary Fund (p10, printed p20): User fees 418,350 + Other 4,734 = Total receipts 423,084 (detail 41, 42). Difference 431,012 - 423,084 = 7,928 is exactly the accrual-to-cash adjustment '(In)decrease accounts receivable (7,928)' on the proprietary Statement of Cash Flows (p7). Both totals are printed as recorded; no line is missing or doubled.

Statement (p6, accrual): Utility operations 267,333 + Depreciation 85,511 + non-operating Debt service - interest 13,687 = 366,531. Budgetary-basis schedule (p10): DISBURSEMENTS 567,574 (detail 43, one printed line, no breakdown), with Debt service 160,000 shown separately under other financing (detail 44, not in the expenditure total). The schedule counts cash disbursements (incl. equipment/capital purchases and working-capital changes, cf. p7 '(In)decrease in equipment 36,020', accounts payable 5,919, accrued liabilities (8,494)) and excludes depreciation; the statement counts accrual expenses incl. depreciation 85,511. The two printed totals 366,531 and 567,574 genuinely differ (schedule above by 201,043); the single printed disbursements line cannot be reconciled line by line.
